subject: Infosec recap + evidence request (SOC 2, logs, DPA) — next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@finlytics.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Infosec recap + evidence request (SOC 2, logs, DPA) — next steps

Jordan / Priya — thanks for taking the time today. Quick written recap so we’re aligned and have an action plan for the security/compliance items you asked about.

Summary of pain points you flagged:
- Regulatory requirement to retain audit logs for 7 years for a subset of financial workflows.
- Need SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent evidence for security posture.
- Proof of pen test (external) or third-party assessment for the hosted inference environment.
- Contract-level language: DPA tweaks and specific data retention clauses.

What we commit to providing by EOD Thursday (2026-12-03):
1) SOC 2 summary and redacted control matrix (attached: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf). We can provide the full report under NDA — confirm if you need full PDF or only a SOC 2 letter.
2) Sample audit-log export showing the schema and retention policies (attached: redwood_audit-log-sample.csv). This demonstrates event types, timestamps, user-id hashes, and storage TTL.
3) Draft DPA with callouts for log retention and subprocessor list (attached: dpa-draft-20261201.docx). Please mark any redlines you need; Marcus is on copy to triage negotiation items.
4) Pen test evidence: we’ll surface our most recent third-party pen test summary and scope. Full vendor report requires a data-disclosure request; let us know if you want the vendor contacts or a redacted version.

Config options we discussed:
- Default hosted retention: 90 days for request/response payloads, 365 days for structured logs.
- Enterprise retention option: configurable retention windows and archival to customer-managed buckets for up to 7 years (works with Redwood Private or a Dedicated contract).
- Option to route only metadata/artifacts out of the hosted service while keeping payloads in your VPC (we discussed this for highest compliance cases).

Suggested next steps / mutual action plan:
- You: confirm whether FinLytics requires full SOC 2 PDF under NDA or the summary + control matrix is sufficient.
- You: send any template clauses from legal for the DPA redline priority (retention clauses + subprocessors).
- Us: provide SOC 2 redacted report, audit-log sample, DPA draft, and pen-test summary by 2026-12-03 EOD.
- Follow-up call: proposed 2026-12-06 to review redlines and retention architecture.

If anything above is missing or misstated, flag it and I’ll correct immediately. Thanks again — we want to make procurement and compliance as seamless as possible.

Regards,

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0164

[Attachment: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 430KB)]
[Attachment: redwood_audit-log-sample.csv (CSV, 12KB)]
[Attachment: dpa-draft-20261201.docx (DOCX, 58KB)]

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@finlytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Infosec recap + evidence request (SOC 2, logs, DPA) — next steps

Camila — really appreciate the clear recap. Couple of follow-ups from our InfoSec side: 

1) SOC 2: we need a Type II report (not just an internal control matrix). If you can share the full Type II under NDA that would speed legal review. Who is our contact for the NDA?

2) Pen test: can you confirm the scope included the inference runtime (GPU hosts) and the control plane endpoints? If the pen test covered only the control plane, we’ll need confirmation of planned coverage for the runtime or timeline for the next test.

3) Retention: 7-year archival is a hard requirement for the payments ingestion path. Is the enterprise retention option available immediately on a Dedicated contract or only on Private? We need to know timing and any migration effort for historical logs.

4) Evidence format: for audit purposes we prefer CSV + SHA256 checksums and a signed attestation from Redwood that the logs were exported as-of a given time. Is that possible?

We’re also going to loop in procurement and legal — Priya is on copy. Once we have the SOC2 and pen test scope details we’ll schedule the 12/6 call.

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Information Security | FinLytics
jordan.hayes@finlytics.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@finlytics.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 10:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Infosec recap + evidence request (SOC 2, logs, DPA) — next steps

Jordan — great questions, answers below and a couple of specific asks from our side. Marcus and Stephanie are copied: Marcus will handle contract/DPA redlines, Stephanie will coordinate the pen test artifacts and vendor contact.

1) SOC 2 Type II: we can provide the full Type II report under NDA. Please send us the standard Redwood Confidentiality NDA or, if you prefer, we can sign FinLytics’s mutual NDA. Contact for NDA intake: contracts@redwood.com (attn: Marcus Lin).

2) Pen test scope: the latest third-party assessment covered both the control plane and the hosted inference runtime (including a sample of GPU host configurations). The vendor performed external network testing and authenticated application testing against our staging and prod-like environments. We will include a summary of scope and the vendor point-of-contact with the pen test summary we send. Full vendor report requires a data access request (standard practice) — we can provide a redacted vendor report up front.

3) 7-year retention: available immediately on Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private. For Hosted accounts we offer an enterprise retention add-on with archival to a customer-managed S3/GCS bucket; enabling archival for historical logs typically takes 3-5 business days post-contract. Migration of historical data depends on the size of the archive; we’ll provide an ingestion estimate once we know volume.

4) Evidence format & attestation: yes — we can export logs in CSV with SHA256 checksums and provide a signed attestation (PDF) stating export timestamps. We’ll include sample CSV + checksum in today’s package.

Attachments in this email: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (redacted control matrix), redwood_audit-log-sample.csv, dpa-draft-20261201.docx.

Requests for you to expedite process:
- Please confirm whether FinLytics prefers Redwood’s standard mutual NDA or to circulate your NDA.
- Share any specific DPA clauses you plan to insist on (retention clause text preferred).

Next call: 2026-12-06 16:00 ET — I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0164
